summary.en: Ran is invited to attend a Valentine's party by a young man and Conan, being jealous, follows her. During the party, Katsuhiko, the party host, is poisoned. Location: Minagawa household-yard Victim: Katsuhiko Minagawa Cause of death: Poison (poisoned chocolate) Suspects: Toshihide Wakamatsu, Kaori Sekiya, Yoshimi Watanabe, Naomichi Tanaka, and Sayuri Minagawa Katsuhiko collapsed dead onto the ground from poison outside his house after eating a piece of Yoshimi's chocolate.
